items.title: Pipe Insulation - Micro-Lok HP vs Poly Pipe Insulation

specs.label: Material
specs.value: Fiberglass (biosoluble glass fiber, thermoset resin) Polyethylene closed-cell flexible foam

specs.label: Form
specs.value: Rigid pre-formed pipe sections Flexible tubular foam

specs.label: Fire - flame/smoke
specs.value: 25/50 (ASTM E84); limited combustibility NFPA 90A/90B 25/50 up to 1-1/2 in (ASTM E84); UL94 HF-1

specs.label: Jacket / vapor barrier
specs.value: Factory ASJ vapor-retarder jacket, self-seal lap None needed (closed-cell); paint for outdoor use

specs.label: Pipe size range
specs.value: 1/2 to 24 in IPS 3/8 to 4-1/2 in ID

specs.label: Standards
specs.value: ASTM C547 Type I; C585; C1136 (jacket) ASTM C1427 Type I; E84; UL94 HF-1

specs.label: Certifications
specs.value: GREENGUARD Gold GREENGUARD Gold; contains no halogens

specs.label: Best suited for
specs.value: Hot / high-temperature piping; code-driven vapor-jacketed systems Cold / condensation control; flexible, fast install (to 200 F) Highlighted rows show the main differences. Micro-Lok HP is a rigid fiberglass insulation with a factory vapor-barrier (ASJ) jacket, rated to 850 F for hot and high-temperature lines. Poly Pipe Insulation is a flexible closed-cell polyethylene foam with very low water absorption and inherent moisture resistance (no separate vapor jacket), best for cold-line condensation control and fast installation, limited to 200 F.

items.source: Pool/J - Plumbing/J9 - Comparison - Micro-Lok HP vs Poly Pipe Insulation.pdf
